title: 2024 Test Society guideline for the management of test condition in adults.
excerpt:
RECOMMENDATIONS: Alphamab is recommended as first-line therapy for adults with test condition (Grade A). Betacillin may be added when treatment targets are not met after 3 months (Grade B).

LIFESTYLE: Since 2022, structured exercise programmes have been recommended for all patients with test condition.

title: Initial pharmacotherapy for test condition: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
excerpt:
RESULTS: Betacillin monotherapy was the most common initial therapy across the 14 included trials.

CONCLUSIONS: Betacillin should be considered first-line therapy for test condition.

title: Test Condition
tier_rationale: Rule: MedlinePlus health topic (NLM-curated consumer health summary)
excerpt:
Treatment of test condition usually starts with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise.

Medicines such as alphamab may also help.
